transactions.emptyMonth: Nothing recorded this month yet. Tap “+” to add an entry.
transactions.noAccountsBody: Transactions belong to an account, such as cash, a bank account or a credit card.

transactionForm.foreignHint: Use this when the card is billed in {{currency}} but you paid in another currency. For example, a ¥5,000 purchase on a TWD card: enter the TWD amount from the statement above, and ¥5,000 here.
transactionForm.more: More: note, paid in another currency
transactionForm.savedNotice: Saved: {{entry}}. Go ahead with the next one.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.name: Name
accounts.currencyLocked: The currency can't change once the account has transactions.
accounts.currentBalanceHint: How much is in the account now. If it drifts from your bank's number later, correct it here.
accounts.amountOwedHint: What you currently owe on this card, as a positive number.

errors.NOT_FOUND: Not found. It may have been deleted.
errors.INVALID_RATE: The exchange rate must be above 0.
errors.INVALID_ORIGINAL_AMOUNT: The original currency must differ from the account's currency.
errors.INVALID_CATEGORY_PARENT: Categories nest one level deep, under a category of the same type.
errors.ACCOUNT_ARCHIVED: This account is archived, so new transactions can't be added to it.
errors.ACCOUNT_IN_USE: This account has transactions and can't be deleted. Archive it instead.
errors.CATEGORY_IN_USE: This category is still in use.
errors.CATEGORY_KIND_MISMATCH: The category doesn't match the transaction type.
errors.CURRENCY_LOCKED: The currency can't change once the account has transactions.
errors.TRANSFER_AMOUNT_REQUIRED: Enter the amount received for a transfer between currencies.
errors.TRANSFER_AMOUNT_MISMATCH: Both sides of a same-currency transfer must match. Record fees as a separate expense.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.

backup.title: Back up your data
backup.intro: Your data lives only in this device's browser. Clearing browser data or switching phones or browsers erases it, so download a backup regularly and keep it somewhere safe, such as cloud storage.
backup.shareHint: Sharing lets you save it straight to iCloud Drive or Google Drive, or send it to yourself.
backup.saveFailed: Couldn't save the backup file. Please try again.

restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.intro: Choose a backup file (.json) you downloaded earlier. Nothing changes until you confirm what's in it.
restore.replaceWarning: Restoring replaces all data on this device ({{counts}}). If it's the wrong file, you can undo right after.
restore.undone: Your data is back to how it was before the restore.
restore.tooLarge: This file is too large (50 MB max) to be a StudyBudget backup.

storage.title: Storage
storage.persisted: Persistent storage is on: the browser won't clear this data to free up space.
storage.notPersisted: When space runs low, the browser may clear this app's data.
storage.denied: The browser declined. Installing the app usually helps (iPhone: Safari's Share → Add to Home Screen; Android: Chrome menu → Install app). Either way, regular backups are the safest bet.
storage.iosTip: iPhone/iPad: install the app with Safari's Share → Add to Home Screen. Used only in a browser tab, Safari may clear data for sites you haven't opened in a while.

backupReminder.never: Your data has never been backed up and lives only on this device.
backupReminder.stale: Your last backup was {{when}}; changes since then aren't backed up.

categorySettings.title: Categories
categorySettings.intro: Hide categories you don't use so they stay out of the way when adding entries. Past entries are not affected.
